verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm offering legal advisory services such as venture capital, IP, data protection and employee share schemes. It is not a software product with a user interface, so asking whether its API matches its UI is a category error. The mention of internal technologies like AI and a blockchain-based trading platform does not show a client-facing UI or API product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
